claims.claim: MP Materials reported Q2 2026 NdPr production of 840 MT (+41% YoY), NdPr sales of 1,006 MT (+127%), $108.5M revenue (+89%), and a new long-term separated-gadolinium offtake with a U.S. aerospace/defense customer.
MP also launched Project Swarm to aggregate drone-industry demand and standardize magnet specifications, with subscription agreements from multiple U.S. and allied customers.

factors.name: domestic rare-earth vertical integration
factors.basis: Rising separated-product output, magnetics revenue and new defense/offtake programs broaden evidence of downstream conversion.

risks.risk: Economics are partly supported by government price protection and strategic commitments, increasing policy/contract dependence.

unknowns.unknown: Long-run standalone economics absent government support and exact new-customer volumes remain unknown.

claims.claim: Q2 Magnetics Segment revenue was $16.5M with $7.5M adjusted EBITDA, while consolidated adjusted EBITDA was $28.5M; the company is simultaneously scaling 10X, Independence and heavy-rare-earth programs.

factors.name: execution conversion
factors.basis: Commercial magnetics revenue/EBITDA and record-scale NdPr sales show tangible conversion while major capacity programs remain forward execution tests.

risks.risk: Large simultaneous expansion programs create construction, commissioning, customer qualification and capital-allocation risk.

unknowns.unknown: 10X commissioning is future-dated and its realized utilization/economics cannot yet be treated as achieved.
